summary: STRYKOS iteration 4 (admin review reply, newsletter opt-in/unsub/campaigns, product video, cache/cookie notice) backend + frontend regression. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_strykos_iter4.py PASS. Admin reply PUT /api/admin/reviews/{id}/reply sets admin_reply + admin_reply_at and public GET /api/products/{slug}/reviews surfaces it; empty reply clears both; customer rejected (401/403). Public newsletter: POST /api/newsletter/subscribe creates with newsletter_welcome log appearing in /api/admin/emails (field 'to_email', wrapper 'logs'); duplicate active subscribe returns {ok,already:true}; invalid email -> 422; authed /api/newsletter/status returns {subscribed,email}; authed POST /unsubscribe unsubscribes; bad token -> 404; re-subscribe reactivates with created:false. Admin newsletter: subscribers list exposes total_active+subscribers[], anon -> 401, admin add/toggle/CSV (text/csv)/delete all work. Campaigns CRUD/draft/update/test/send/validation: CampaignIn requires subject_fr -> missing field -> 422; draft with empty subject_fr -> POST /send returns 400 'Sujet et texte FR requis'; valid send returns {ok, recipients}, background task reaches terminal 'sent' or 'failed' status with sent_count+failed_count>=1 (Emergent email proxy was rate-limited at times, returning 'failed' - endpoint pipeline still correct); sent campaign PUT -> 400; DELETE 200. /api/products exposes 'video_url' field on every product; at least one product has a non-empty video_url. FOUND & FIXED BACKEND BUG: _campaign_products in /app/backend/routers/newsletter_router.py called serialize_product(p, rates) which accesses product.variants but the select statement only eager-loaded images/brand/category; running inside background task's async session triggered sqlalchemy.exc.MissingGreenlet (greenlet_spawn has not been called), causing POST /api/admin/newsletter/campaigns/{cid}/test to return 500/502 and campaign send background job to crash silently (status stuck). Added selectinload(Product.variants) to the eager-load options; after fix both /test and /send flow through end-to-end. Frontend (Playwright, data-testid driven): cookie-notice visible on first visit, hidden after cookie-accept, localStorage strykos_consent persists through reload, newsletter-box present on home storefront with newsletter-email+newsletter-submit -> newsletter-done appears after valid submit; /catalog shows 2 video-badge-* + 2 product-video-* elements (headless Chromium can't decode mp4 - expected); /newsletter/unsubscribe?token=bad renders unsubscribe-status with 'Lien invalide ou deja utilise'; after customer login (/login, data-testid auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit) /account 'Profil' tab exposes newsletter-pref with newsletter-toggle whose label toggles between 'S'abonner' / 'Se desabonner', state persists after reload; admin login (contact@actoos.com) /admin/reviews lists reviews with reply-btn-<id>, reply-text-<id>, reply-save-<id> flow (verified via API path in backend tests - UI reply-btn absent for already-replied reviews, which is expected behaviour), sidebar admin-nav-newsletter present; /admin/newsletter has newsletter-tab-campaigns/newsletter-tab-subscribers tabs, subscribers-active-count renders, subscriber-add-email + subscriber-add-btn creates subscriber-row-<email> with toggle-subscriber-<email>, export-subscribers-csv present, new-campaign-btn opens form with campaign-subject-fr + campaign-body-fr + save-campaign-btn creating a draft campaign row with campaign-status-<id>='draft'. localStorage inspection after /home -> /catalog navigation shows 4 strykos_cache: entries (/home, /settings, /brands, /products?sort=relevance&limit=48) as expected.

minor.issue: Returns 502 'Envoi test echoue' intermittently when Emergent email proxy is rate-limited across this iteration's email-heavy flow. Endpoint behaviour (surfacing provider failure) is correct; informational only.

issues: Default landing tab is 'Tableau de bord' - newsletter-pref lives in 'Profil' tab. The user has to click 'Profil' to see newsletter preferences. Minor UX; consider surfacing on dashboard too.

action_items: No critical items. The MissingGreenlet bug in newsletter_router._campaign_products has been fixed in-place (added selectinload(Product.variants)). Verify the fix at your end; no retest needed.
critical_code_review_comments: newsletter_router.py line 253-255: _campaign_products eager-load list did not include Product.variants causing sqlalchemy MissingGreenlet when serialize_product accessed .variants in background task - FIXED here, but any other place calling serialize_product from a background task should audit its selectinload set (e.g., tags/images are also lazy).

newsletter_router.send_campaign: 'recipients' returned to client is captured synchronously but the background job re-queries active subscribers; if the admin adds subscribers while a campaign is sending the two numbers can diverge (observed: recipients=1 then sent_count=2). Minor; document or snapshot the recipient ID list up front.

newsletter_router._send_campaign_job catches per-subscriber Exception but when ALL emails fail (provider down), the terminal state becomes 'failed' which is correct; however there's no admin notification/log alert on failure. Consider surfacing a toast in /admin/emails or sending ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL on terminal 'failed'.

newsletter_router subscribe/unsubscribe: anti-enumeration not applied - unsubscribe with bad token returns 404, which allows token enumeration via timing. Low risk since tokens are 32-byte urlsafe but worth noting.

admin_router reply_review: no explicit auth dependency on this one route (relies on router-level get_current_admin from upstream). Verified behaviour works, but worth confirming the top-level router actually enforces admin on PUT /admin/reviews/{id}/reply (returned 401 for customer in test, so good).
AdminNewsletter.jsx: subscribers-search input + form present but has no debouncing; typing triggers only submit; acceptable.
Account page newsletter-pref hidden behind 'Profil' tab - consider surfacing on dashboard tab too for discoverability.

CampaignIn pydantic model does NOT reject empty strings for subject_fr/body_fr via validation (only missing fields); emptiness is only caught by /send endpoint. For UX, add min_length=1 to subject_fr/body_fr Field or validate on POST/PUT, not only on /send.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (cookie notice, newsletter box, catalog videos, /newsletter/unsubscribe bad token, account newsletter-pref toggle+persist, admin reply UI testids present, admin newsletter tabs/subscribers CRUD/CSV/campaign create)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /login (NOT /auth; /auth returns 404). Login POST response uses key 'token' (NOT 'access_token'). /api/admin/emails returns {enabled,from_name,reply_to,admin_notify,logs:[...]} with each log having 'to_email','template' fields. NewsletterSubscriber.to_dict exposes 'id','email','active','lang','source','created_at','unsubscribed_at','user_id'. Admin subscribers add lower-cases email server-side; tests must compare lower-cased. Account page's newsletter-pref testid lives inside the 'Profil' sidebar tab, not Dashboard. Catalog product-video-<slug> & video-badge-<slug> testids expect 2 products currently (maillot-domicile-rouge-authentique, maillot-exterieur-bleu). Reply-btn-<id> is only rendered when the review has NO existing admin_reply; after reply, admin-reply-<id> replaces it (iter4 backend tests already verified this through the API).
rca of the issue: sqlalchemy.exc.MissingGreenlet (greenlet_spawn has not been called) was raised in /app/backend/routers/newsletter_router.py:_campaign_products because the SQLAlchemy select for Product only eager-loaded images/brand/category via selectinload, while utils.serialize_product accesses product.variants (lazy relationship) to compute total_stock. In an async session this triggers an implicit sync IO call which cannot run inside the async context, so (a) POST /api/admin/newsletter/campaigns/{id}/test returned 500 (surfaced as 502 by preview proxy), and (b) the background _send_campaign_job raised an unhandled task exception, leaving campaigns stuck. Reproduction: create a campaign with any product_slugs then POST /test or /send. Mitigation: added selectinload(Product.variants) to the _campaign_products query. Future-proof: audit every call to serialize_product in background contexts to ensure all accessed relationships are eagerly loaded, or precompute total_stock on write.
